recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not duplicate the THO CodeSystem concept locally in core; any remaining release-management work belongs in THO/UTG.
issue_request: FHIR-52872 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asks to add code `symptom` with display `Symptom` and a symptom definition to the Observation Category code system at terminology.hl7.org.
initial_application: No FHIR-core source commit mentioning FHIR-52872 was found. The relevant core source already includes `http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category` in `source/observation/valueset-observation-category.xml`, and `Observation.category` binds to that ValueSet. The applying source change was made externally through UP-738 in UTG/THO.
additional_context: FHIR-34408, FHIR-37560, and FHIR-50889 are the same symptom/change family, with FHIR-34408 also carrying a related exam-definition update. UP-717 was the earlier unresolved UTG ticket and UP-738 is the implemented UTG proposal. OO minutes and Zulip confirm the intended route was an external terminology update for R6.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because the core source delegates the code list to THO and the current THO/current FHIR build already include `symptom`.
